review_method: Root agent visually inspected the four actual Godot GPU captures combined in the comparison. No concept render replaces the TileMap output.
pixel_policy: Whole artist masters nearest-registered to1024 period; original RGBA samples, no procedural repaint or recolour. Existing calibrated brick/wood periods reused unchanged.
visual_findings: Warm ochre sandy soil, cool grey compacted gravel and olive-grey mossed stone are visibly distinct at the existing game scale.
Small robot and white station remain readable over the three surfaces.
All maps preserve the shared coping, facade, bridge heads, rails, hatch, robot and station scale.
Thirteen-material mixed map keeps common ground occupancy and exterior structure across material changes.
Gravel and moss are flat albedo details and do not add objects, holes, collision or navigation boundaries.
